    link: str | None
    email_subject: str

    output_schema=PasswordResetLink
)

if result.has_link and result.link:
    print(f"Here is your TechServices password reset link: {result.link}")
else:
    raise ValueError(f"Could not find a valid password reset link. Reason: {result.reason}")
